definitions.gloss: to drink together; to exchange drinks
definitions.explanation: To share drinks with someone, typically alcoholic beverages, in a convivial setting. Implies a mutual, social act of drinking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{杯|さかずき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わした。
examples.english: I shared cups of sake with an old friend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{更|ふ}ける⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{仲間|なかま}→仲間：03498_nakama⟧たち⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧、⟦{昔話|むかしばなし}→昔話：12718_mukashibanashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{咲|さ}かせた→咲く：08150_saku⟧。
examples.english: We drank together with friends until late at night, chatting happily about old times.

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) + ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ (to exchange, do mutually). The ⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧ element gives the verb its sense of shared, reciprocal action.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the drink: ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わす

COMMON OBJECTS:
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to drink sake together
- {杯|さかずき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to share cups of sake
- ⟦ワイン→ワイン：01067_wain⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飲|の}み{交|か}わす: to drink wine together

REGISTER:
Slightly literary and warm in tone. Often appears in descriptions of bonding, reunions, and celebrations. In casual speech, ⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ is more common.

OTHER ～{交|か}わす VERBS:
- ⟦{言葉|ことば}を{交|か}わす→言葉を交わす：19502_kotobawokawasu⟧: to exchange words
- ⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{交|か}わす→交わす：19373_kawasu⟧: to make a promise with each other
